summary: Tested B33 Mobile Offline/Sync/Conflict Resolution and B34 Homie Avatar/Voice/Multimodal runtime end-to-end. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases pass covering sync push idempotency, blocked offline reward_redeem, stale-review conflict detection & creation, /status /conflicts, all 4 resolve choices (keep_mine/use_latest/save_as_note/discard), 409 on re-resolve, /media/finalize checksum dedupe, saved-questions CRUD (including empty=400, delete-then-404), /safety-content, voice sessions (start/get, invalid mode 400), ask (normal structured response + emergency 'I smell gas' -> emergency=true urgent+warning, empty=400), speech (low<0.5 prompt_repeat, high >=0.5 no repeat), handsfree (next_step requires project=400, ask/pause/stop project-optional, unknown=400, needs_confirmation path), admin voice settings GET/PUT + /dashboard. Frontend (mobile 390x844): demo user login OK; /home-intel tiles hi-sync and hi-voice present; Sync Center renders Connection card (Online), Needs-your-review conflicts with sync-resolve-<id>-<choice> buttons (all 4), Saved-for-Homie section, and Emergency guidance cards (gas leak, fire, medical, flood, shock) all offline-visible. Voice screen: session starts, voice-input/voice-send/voice-mic/voice-large-text/voice-mute all present, emergency prompt renders red urgent card with safety text and NO normal guidance, normal ask returns cautionary emotion chip + gesture:explain + action cards + captions, accessibility toggles switch state. Admin (desktop 1280x900): admin-nav-proworkspace / admin-nav-datagovernance / admin-nav-voice tiles all present; ProWorkspace + DataGovernance regression content renders. HOWEVER Voice & Avatar admin module content is BLANK — API GET /api/hi/admin/voice/dashboard is never fired from the browser after clicking admin-nav-voice, so voice-toggle-input/output/avatar/highrisk, voice-limit-input, voice-limit-save are absent from the DOM. Backend endpoint itself works (tested via pytest with admin token). Root-cause: likely useFocusEffect in VoiceModule not firing on child-mount when parent screen is already focused (or a hook/effect regression); other modules using same pattern do fire.

ui_bugs.issue: Module content never renders — no GET /api/hi/admin/voice/dashboard is fired after admin-nav-voice click. voice-toggle-input/output/avatar/highrisk and voice-limit-input/voice-limit-save are absent from DOM. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/admin/VoiceModule.tsx:15-20 (useFocusEffect/load).

integration_issues.issue: Frontend never calls /api/hi/admin/voice/dashboard when the Voice tab is selected. Suggested fix: replace useFocusEffect with useEffect(load, []) inside VoiceModule (child components of an already-focused screen don't reliably fire useFocusEffect on mount).

action_items: Fix VoiceModule.tsx: swap useFocusEffect for a plain useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]) so the initial /hi/admin/voice/dashboard load fires when the module mounts inside an already-focused admin screen. After fix, admin-nav-voice content, provider toggles and free-plan limit save will render/work.
Consider adding the same fallback to any other admin sub-module that appears blank on first mount.

rca_of_issue: Symptom: Voice & Avatar admin module renders only its container; sub-tree is empty; no network request to /api/hi/admin/voice/dashboard is made. Repro: login admin, /admin, click admin-nav-voice. Expected: dashboard payload loads and toggles/limits appear. Actual: content area blank. Cause: VoiceModule.tsx uses useFocusEffect (from expo-router) inside a child component. The parent /admin screen is already focused when the child mounts, so the focus event that would trigger the callback has already fired and does not re-fire on child mount, leaving `loading=true` and `dash=null`. Fix: use useEffect(() => { load(); }, [load]) instead (or in addition to) useFocusEffect for initial data load.
